headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: Revenue rose across the sector, with TCS reporting ₹73,188 cr and a 24% margin. HCLTech showed strong AI-driven profit growth and reaffirmed its FY27 guidance. Mid‑tier players LTM and Tech Mahindra posted double‑digit top‑line growth. Several peers have not yet released results, keeping the outlook incomplete.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: HCLTech highlighted AI sales driving profit, while TCS and Wipro noted AI revenue crossing 10% of total.

themes.title: Steady dividend payouts
themes.detail: Most reporting companies declared or maintained dividends, supporting shareholder returns.

leaders.why: Largest revenue, strong margin and positive AI revenue
High profit growth and clear FY27 guidance
13.6% YoY revenue rise and dividend increase

laggards.why: Results not released despite strong prior growth
